pictures.t: Tectonic setting of the Mercure Basin area
pictures.c: Map showing a) the tectonic setting of the Mercure Basin area; and b) the tectonic lineament as derived from air photo interpretation respect to outcrops of recent continental deposits (from Brozzetti et al. [2009]).
Detail of the trace of the Piana Perretti fault traced on a 5 m resolution DEM, and photo showing possible tectonic tilt of recent deposits (from Brozzetti et al. [2009]).
Relocalized 1998 Mercure earthquake sequence and focal mechanisms of larger events mapped on the pattern of recent faults (from Brozzetti et al. [2009]).

pictures.t: Cross sections across the 1998 Mercure earthquake sequence
pictures.c: NNE-SSW trending cross-sections showing relocalized 1998 Mercure earthquake sequence and its relationships with surface faults (from Brozzetti et al. [2009]).

pictures.t: Scheme of the 1998 earthquake seismogenic source
pictures.c: Scheme showing geometry of the hypothesized Piana Perretti seismogenic Fault and relationships with the associated earthquake sequence. The Castelluccio-Rotonda Fault falls in the hanging-wall of the Piana Perretti Fault (from Brozzetti et al. [2009]).
